name: command-queue
subject: Show the durable local CLI command queue.
objective: Inspect command lifecycle and reconnect to output without rerunning work.
acceptance: Preserve persistent command IDs and all six server states; closing output never cancels execution. Unavailable local authority is not an empty queue.

name: event-base
subject: Project shared event fields before combining run-owned records.
objective: Provide the narrow retained event evidence needed for inspection and run import-coverage analysis.
acceptance: The result unions retained audit, domain, tool, and issue records with their available run identity; an empty or unavailable preview cannot establish zero source activity or complete import coverage.

name: audit-event-runs
subject: Count imported audit records per run before combining event sources.
objective: Bound audit evidence for run import-coverage analysis.
acceptance: Count only retained audit records with event identity by run attempt; missing evidence does not establish zero activity.

name: domain-event-runs
subject: Count imported domain records per run before combining event sources.
objective: Bound domain evidence for run import-coverage analysis.
acceptance: Count only retained domain records with event identity by run attempt; missing evidence does not establish zero activity.

name: tool-event-runs
subject: Count imported tool records per run before combining event sources.
objective: Bound tool evidence for run import-coverage analysis.
acceptance: Count only retained tool records with event identity by run attempt; missing evidence does not establish zero activity.

name: issue-event-runs
subject: Count imported issue records per run before combining event sources.
objective: Bound issue evidence for run import-coverage analysis.
acceptance: Count only retained issue records with event identity by run attempt; missing evidence does not establish zero activity.

name: event-runs
subject: Identify each workflow run that has one or more imported run-owned records.
objective: Identify run attempts with retained imported records so their presence can be compared with observed runs.
acceptance: One row per organization, repository, workflow, run, and attempt contains events, the count of matching retained records; no row in an available result does not prove that no event was produced.
description: Distinct workflow runs represented by imported domain, tool, audit, or issue records.

name: run-import-status
subject: Identify observed runs that have one or more imported run-owned records.
objective: Compare observed run attempts with retained run-owned event evidence to locate import-coverage gaps for investigation.
acceptance: Keep each observed run and its run-attempt identity; imported-event-count is zero and imported is false without a matching retained event, but missing events alone do not establish an ingestion failure.
description: Observed runs enriched with imported-record status.

name: workflow-run-totals
subject: Summarize observed run counts and imported runs by declared workflow.
objective: Compare observed run attempts, conclusions, and imported-record coverage for each workflow.
acceptance: Group by organization, repository, and workflow; report distinct run-attempt totals, successful and failed conclusion counts, and imported-run totals only from retained evidence. Missing run records cannot establish zero execution.
description: Observed run and imported-run totals for each declared workflow.

name: workflow-aic-run-totals
subject: Summarize observed run attempts and AI Credits for workflow cost comparison.
objective: Count retained run attempts and recorded AI Credits without loading imported-event coverage.
acceptance: Count all distinct retained run attempts, but include only positive recorded AIC in cost totals and cost denominators; zero and missing telemetry cannot skew cost averages.

name: workflow-aic-totals
subject: Summarize observed AI Credit usage by declared workflow.
objective: Expose retained AI Credit consumption per workflow for bounded cost review alongside observed execution.
acceptance: Sum only positive recorded aic-total by organization, repository, and workflow; exclude zero and missing costs rather than treating them as free execution.
description: Observed AI Credit totals for each declared workflow.

name: mcp-tool-workflow-totals
subject: Summarize observed MCP calls by tool and workflow before the tool inventory is materialized.
objective: Keep MCP inventory intermediates bounded without dropping calls or changing byte totals.
acceptance: Count retained observation identities and sum request and response bytes per server, tool, and workflow; retain safe-output-server classification for downstream exclusion.

name: mcp-tool-calls
subject: Prepare MCP tool calls for aggregation with safe-output-server calls identified for downstream exclusion.
objective: Identify retained MCP call labels and safe-output-server classification for downstream tool-use investigation.
acceptance: Preserve each retained call with its workflow key and tool label and mark safe-output-server calls explicitly; downstream exclusion must not be mistaken for absence of those calls or complete tool telemetry.
description: Observed MCP tool calls labeled with whether they belong to the internal safe outputs server.

name: issue-safe-outputs
subject: List retained GitHub issue safe outputs.
objective: Inspect retained issue safe outputs and their observed closure state before deciding which items need follow-up.
acceptance: Include only safe_output.result issue records, not pull requests; preserve issue and run links, timestamps, state, and status detail. Unknown or unobserved closure state must not be presented as closed.
description: Issue-only projection of retained safe-output items.

name: issue-safe-output-label-options
subject: List observed safe-output badges for the issue list Labels filter.
objective: Choose retained safe-output types without scanning or filtering presented cards.
acceptance: Return distinct observed badge values in ascending order; missing evidence is not an empty label inventory.

name: issue-status-label-options
subject: List observed status badges for the issue list Status filter.
objective: Choose retained issue states and closing reasons without inferring resolution.
acceptance: Return distinct observed status details in ascending order; Unknown remains distinct from Open and Closed.

name: issue-repository-totals
subject: Rank the ten repositories with the most retained GitHub issue safe outputs.
objective: Locate repositories with the largest observed issue-safe-output volume for a bounded review of linked records.
acceptance: Return at most ten repository coordinates ordered by retained issue-record count; ties or missing issue evidence must not imply a complete fleet ranking or unique issue count.
description: Top repositories by retained issue safe-output count.

name: campaign-workflow-import-evidence
subject: Summarize retained import evidence at workflow grain for campaign inventory quality.
objective: Preserve import-evidence provenance without materializing per-run ingestion indicators.
acceptance: Compose all four retained event sources with the same availability, freshness, and completeness as event-runs; counts describe retained records, not executions or outcomes.

name: campaign-workflow-execution-base
subject: Summarize retained run attempts and AI Credits before campaign workflow enrichment.
objective: Read run identity and recorded AI Credits together instead of enriching every run with import status.
acceptance: Count distinct run-attempt identities and sum aic-total per organization, repository, and workflow; missing retained evidence is not proof of no execution or cost.

name: campaign-workflow-execution-totals
subject: Attach retained import-evidence quality to compact workflow execution totals.
objective: Preserve the public inventory's run and import availability composition after aggregating run evidence.
acceptance: Keep runs and AI Credits unchanged; unavailable run evidence fails closed and optional import evidence degrades quality exactly as in run-import-status.
description: The import-evidence join preserves inventory provenance without per-run ingestion indicators. It follows run aggregation so unavailable run evidence retains the original failure-quality semantics.

name: campaign-workflow-declarations
subject: Project reusable campaign workflow declarations without execution evidence.
objective: Share declaration display fields between structural topology and execution inventory without joining runs or import evidence.
acceptance: Preserve raw organization, repository, workflow and declaration fields for joins. Select orchestrator and worker roles once, retaining inactive and unknown declarations; only list consumers select active entries. Display defaults and repository links do not establish execution, enrollment or authority.

name: campaign-workflow-inventory
subject: Project declared campaign workflows with lean execution and configuration evidence.
objective: Provide campaign totals and lists from shared declarations with separate execution and import-quality evidence.
acceptance: Keep all declared orchestrators and workers, including inactive and unobserved entries; preserve inventory ordering, configuration defaults, execution totals, and import-evidence quality.
description: Lean campaign inventory with execution totals that retain the public workflow inventory's evidence-quality dependencies.

name: workflow-inventory
subject: List declared workflows with their campaign, repository, configuration, and observed execution totals.
objective: Compare declared workflow configuration with retained run, import-coverage, and AI Credit evidence to select a workflow for closer inspection.
acceptance: Keep one row per declared workflow with identity, role, mode, registration, links, observed totals, and ingestion indicator; zero joined totals and missing evidence must not be treated as proof of no execution or complete ingestion.
description: Central campaign and repository-owned workflow inventory with observed execution totals.

name: repository-run-statistics
subject: Reduce run counts, conclusions, and positive AI Credits before repository enrichment.
objective: Share one row-local run aggregate between repository execution and cost summaries.
acceptance: Keep organization/repository grain, distinct run IDs, existing failure and approval counts, and positive recorded AIC. Reduce before joins; missing evidence is not zero activity or free execution.

name: repository-aic-totals
subject: Summarize observed AI Credit usage by repository.
objective: Provide repository-level retained AI Credit totals for comparing observed usage with run activity.
acceptance: Sum only positive recorded aic-total by organization and repository; exclude zero and missing costs rather than treating them as free execution.
description: Observed AI Credit totals for each repository.

name: maintenance-repository-versions
subject: Group installed and current gh-aw compiler versions and upgrade evidence by repository.
objective: Identify repositories with declared Markdown workflows whose retained compiler-version evidence warrants upgrade review.
acceptance: Group Markdown workflow declarations by repository coordinate and return distinct recorded installed/current version lists plus upgrade-required and unknown flags; inspect absent or mixed version evidence rather than inferring a repository-wide installed version.

name: maintenance-repositories
subject: List each repository with recorded compiler versions and computed upgrade state.
objective: Expose recorded compiler versions and computed upgrade state per repository, with its GitHub home URL for inspection.
acceptance: Return repository, repository-url, version lists, upgrade-required, upgrade-state, and upgrade-action-visible. Show Upgrade for outdated or unknown evidence; hide it for known-current repositories. Visibility grants no rollout authority.

name: maintenance-campaign-updates
subject: Expose at most one CAO package update row for the Updates navigation indicator.
objective: Determine whether retained campaign metadata contains an update-available signal for the Updates indicator.
acceptance: Return zero or one campaign-update-state row only when it equals update-available; an empty result means no matching retained signal, not that every campaign is current.

name: maintenance-repository-upgrades
subject: Expose at most one gh-aw compiler upgrade row for the Updates navigation indicator.
objective: Determine whether repository compiler metadata contains an upgrade-required signal for the Updates indicator.
acceptance: Return zero or one upgrade-required row only when the retained value is 1; no row does not establish that all repositories are current when version data is missing.

name: run-incomplete-outcomes
subject: Project retained report-incomplete terminal outcomes as concise run diagnoses.
objective: Find recorded report_incomplete terminal outcomes that can explain a specific run's incomplete reporting.
acceptance: Include only runs with a recorded report_incomplete terminal outcome, preserving run-attempt identity, outcome kind, and recorded diagnosis; absence is not proof that reporting completed.
description: One retained incomplete-evidence diagnosis per workflow Run when the agent explicitly reported that required evidence or access was unavailable.

name: campaign-runs
subject: Project workflow runs with campaign attribution and retained failure evidence.
objective: Connect retained run status and failure details to declared campaign/workflow identity for run-level diagnosis.
acceptance: Expose run and attempt identity, declared attribution, runtime and target repositories, status, failure and incomplete-outcome evidence, timestamps, and drill-down links; do not infer an outcome from runtime success or missing details.
description: Canonical workflow runs joined to their declared campaign and workflow identity.

name: campaign-runtime-health-runs
subject: Project only the run and workflow fields required to classify current campaign runtime health.
objective: Provide the retained run identity, timing, role, dispatch type, repository, and status needed to assess campaign runtime-health groups.
acceptance: Project the selected fields from overview-runs without converting missing statuses or unattributed workflows into failures; unavailable run history leaves health assessment incomplete.
description: A bounded runtime-health input that excludes audit outcomes and presentation-only campaign run fields.

name: campaign-runtime-health-groups
subject: Compute each campaign workflow and runtime repository's latest consecutive failure streak in the selected horizon.
objective: Locate campaign workflow/runtime-repository groups whose most recent retained completed runs have consecutive runtime failures.
acceptance: Group completed runs by campaign, workflow, role, dispatch type, and runtime repository; failure-count is the latest retained failure streak, not a rate or a claim about runs outside the available horizon.
description: Current retained failure streaks grouped by campaign workflow and runtime repository, considering only concluded Runs so an in-flight retry cannot mask an active failure streak.

name: workflow-run-observation-counts
subject: Count retained Runs for each workflow identity in the selected horizon.
objective: Measure retained run presence by workflow identity to compare with active orchestrator declarations.
acceptance: Count overview-runs by organization, repository, and workflow; a missing group indicates no retained matching run in the available horizon, not proof of no executions.
description: One row per organization, repository, and workflow with retained Run counts, safe to join without row multiplication.

name: campaign-active-orchestrator-run-presence
subject: Count retained Runs for each active campaign orchestrator in the selected horizon.
objective: Compare active orchestrator declarations with retained run observations to identify missing visibility.
acceptance: Keep only workflows declared active with orchestrator role and expose their identity, runtime repository, and observed-run-count; a zero joined count means no retained match, not necessarily a stopped schedule.
description: Active campaign orchestrators annotated with retained Run presence.

name: campaign-unobserved-orchestrator-candidates
subject: Mark active campaign orchestrators with no retained Runs in the selected horizon.
objective: Mark active orchestrators lacking retained run evidence for bounded telemetry or schedule review.
acceptance: Preserve active orchestrator identity and observed-run-count; is-unobserved marks zero retained matches and must not be interpreted as a runtime failure or evidence that dispatch was expected.
description: Active orchestrators annotated with whether runtime evidence is absent.

name: campaign-unobserved-orchestrators
subject: Show active campaign orchestrators with no retained Runs in the selected horizon.
objective: List active orchestrator declarations with no retained run observations for follow-up on evidence availability.
acceptance: Return only is-unobserved candidates with their workflow and repository identity; an empty result does not certify run completeness or scheduler health.
description: Active campaign orchestrators whose runtime state cannot be established from retained evidence.

name: dispatches
subject: Select workflow-dispatch runs from campaign-attributed workflow run evidence.
objective: Inspect retained workflow_dispatch runs attributed to campaigns before comparing campaign dispatch activity.
acceptance: Include only campaign-runs with event workflow_dispatch and preserve run, attempt, attribution, status, and time; absence does not establish that no dispatch occurred beyond retained evidence.
description: Canonical workflow runs whose authoritative trigger is workflow_dispatch.

name: campaign-dispatch-inventory
subject: Project retained dispatch identity and campaign attribution before campaign counting.
objective: Count dispatches without materializing run diagnoses and presentation links.
acceptance: Keep workflow_dispatch runs in timestamp order with declared campaign attribution; preserve workflow and incomplete-outcome join quality and duplicate-key failure behavior.
description: Lean dispatch-count input; the incomplete-outcome join preserves the full campaign run source's evidence quality and fail-closed validation.

name: campaign-dispatch-totals
subject: Summarize observed workflow dispatches for each centrally managed campaign.
objective: Compare retained workflow_dispatch run counts across attributed campaigns.
acceptance: Count distinct run identifiers per campaign from dispatches; do not treat missing campaign attribution or unretained dispatches as zero actual activity.
description: Observed workflow-dispatch run totals grouped by campaign.

name: campaign-workflow-totals
subject: Summarize observed workflow and execution totals for each centrally managed campaign.
objective: Compare declared orchestrator/worker composition, rollout registration, observed runs, and AI Credit usage by campaign.
acceptance: Group only orchestrator and worker workflow-inventory rows by campaign; retain workflow count, distinct roles/modes/registration and summed observed runs and AIC, without inferring successful outcomes.
description: Observed workflow, rollout, run, and AI Credit totals grouped by campaign.

name: campaign-repository-coverage
subject: Count distinct registered target repositories reached by successful worker dispatches for each campaign.
objective: Estimate observed campaign target reach from successful worker workflow_dispatch runs joined to registered repositories.
acceptance: Count distinct matched target-repository values per campaign only for successful worker dispatches; this is observed reach, not verified target outcomes or complete fleet coverage.
description: Campaign repository coverage derived from successful worker dispatch runs in the selected horizon.

name: campaign-inventory-preview
subject: Show declared campaigns before execution evidence is evaluated.
objective: Expose campaign identities and navigation links while observed totals remain pending.
acceptance: Preserve every declared campaign and its dashboard link without reporting missing execution totals as zero.

name: campaign-inventory
subject: List centrally managed campaigns with their observed workflow and execution totals.
objective: Compare declared campaigns with retained workflow composition, dispatches, target reach, runs, and AIC to choose an evidence-backed drill-down.
acceptance: Keep declared campaigns with campaign identity and link plus joined totals; defaulted zero values mean no matching retained evidence and cannot certify no activity, complete coverage, or successful outcomes.
description: Canonical campaign inventory enriched with observed workflow, rollout, run, repository coverage, and AI Credit totals.

name: firewall-domain-totals
subject: Show each observed firewall domain with the number of runs and total accepted and blocked requests.
objective: Identify domains with observed denied requests for a closer review of firewall evidence.
acceptance: Report distinct observed runs and native accepted and blocked request totals by domain; a denied request alone does not justify allowing egress, and no row does not prove no requests occurred.
description: Distinct runs and accepted and blocked request totals by firewall domain.

name: firewall-most-blocked-domains
subject: Highlight the domains with the most blocked firewall requests.
objective: Prioritize up to ten observed domains by blocked request total for investigation.
acceptance: Rank by observed blocked totals and inspect underlying domain/workflow evidence before deciding whether a block needs attention; the ranking is not a policy authorization or an incidence rate.
description: The ten domains with the highest observed blocked request totals.

name: firewall-domain-workflows
subject: Show workflows that allowed or blocked requests to each observed firewall domain.
objective: Locate which observed workflows contributed accepted or denied requests for a domain.
acceptance: Preserve workflow scope, source link, distinct runs, and native accepted and blocked totals; investigate the run and egress context rather than assuming a denied request is a failure or grounds for wider access.
description: Workflow-level accepted and blocked request totals by firewall domain.

name: mcp-tool-totals
subject: Group observed MCP activity by tool and count calls and calling workflows, excluding the internal safe outputs server.
objective: Expose tool-level call, workflow, and byte totals to investigate observed MCP usage.
acceptance: Group only observed non-safe-output-server calls by server and tool, preserving counts and byte totals; lack of calls does not establish no access, and call volume does not establish value or permission.
description: Observed MCP tool-call totals grouped by MCP server and tool, with the number of distinct calling workflows.

name: mcp-top-tools
subject: Show the ten most frequently called MCP tools.
objective: Identify up to ten tools with the highest observed non-safe-output-server call counts for inspection.
acceptance: Rank observed calls by tool label and inspect grouped tool evidence before drawing conclusions; do not treat popularity as effectiveness or authority to add tools.
description: The ten MCP tools with the most observed calls, excluding the internal safe outputs server.

name: steering-events
subject: Prepare observed gateway steering warnings for aggregation by steering type and workflow.
objective: Expose warning identity, run context, type, and timestamp for downstream steering diagnostics.
acceptance: Project recorded gateway steering events with workflow and run attribution where available; a warning is not a completed budget overrun, failure, or reason to increase limits.
description: Gateway steering warnings emitted when a run approaches its AI Credit budget, time limit, or another declared limit, labelled with a readable steering type.

name: steering-type-totals
subject: Show how often each kind of steering warning occurred.
objective: Identify steering warning categories to inspect in their run context.
acceptance: Report observed event totals and distinct runs and workflows by type; confirm underlying warnings before interpreting frequency, and do not infer actual limit breaches.
description: Observed gateway steering warnings grouped by steering type with the number of affected runs and workflows.

name: steering-workflow-totals
subject: Count steering warnings for each workflow.
objective: Expose workflow-level warning totals and token/time warning breakdowns for downstream review.
acceptance: Count recorded events and distinct runs by workflow, retaining the declared token/time categories; other types remain in total events and no warning alone establishes a failure.
description: Gateway steering warnings grouped by workflow, split into token-budget and time-limit warnings.

name: steering-workflows
subject: Present workflow steering totals with a link to each workflow dashboard.
objective: Show observed workflow steering totals with navigation to the affected run context.
acceptance: Keep workflow identity, link, events, runs, and warning breakdowns tied to their grouped evidence; use drill-through before recommending changes, not warning counts as a basis to widen budgets.
description: Workflow steering totals labelled with a link to the workflow runtime page.

name: steering-top-workflows
subject: Highlight the workflows with the most steering warnings.
objective: Prioritize up to ten workflows by observed warning count for investigation.
acceptance: Rank recorded warning totals with workflow context, checking underlying events and telemetry coverage; a high rank neither proves overrun nor justifies a limit change.
description: The ten workflows with the highest observed gateway steering warning totals.

name: entity-workflow-run-totals
subject: Summarize run outcomes and AI Credit consumption for reusable workflow cards.
objective: Compare retained run-attempt activity, recorded conclusions, and AI Credit usage per workflow card.
acceptance: Group by organization, repository, and workflow; expose distinct run-attempt count, success/failure conclusion counts, and sum of recorded AIC, without treating missing run history as zero actual activity.

name: entity-workflows
subject: Project workflow entities for reusable workflow cards and repository drill-down.
objective: Relate declared workflows to observed run and AIC totals for workflow-level drill-down.
acceptance: Keep declared workflow identity, role, registration, campaign, link, and joined totals; a missing run match defaults to displayed zeros but does not establish no executions or outcomes.

name: repository-runs
subject: Project canonical runs into repository-addressable run evidence.
objective: Expose retained run chronology and status for a selected repository's drill-down.
acceptance: Retain repository coordinate, workflow, run identity, title, event, start time, conclusion, mode, AIC, and run link; absent details or runs do not establish a healthy or idle repository.
description: Workflow runs with a stable repository route key.

name: repository-workflow-totals
subject: Summarize declared and disabled workflow counts by repository.
objective: Compare declared and disabled workflow counts for each repository in the retained workflow inventory.
acceptance: Count declared workflows and workflow-active=false entries by organization and repository; missing declarations must not be interpreted as a complete zero-workflow inventory.
description: Declared and disabled workflow totals for each repository.

name: repository-report-totals
subject: Summarize published outcome report counts by repository.
objective: Show retained outcome-report volume per repository for comparison with observed execution.
acceptance: Count retained outcome rows by organization and repository; a missing aggregate does not prove no reports were published or that reported outcomes succeeded.
description: Published report totals for each repository.

name: repository-run-identities
subject: Project the run-attempt identities needed to match imported evidence.
objective: Keep import-coverage joins narrow without carrying run details, links, or costs.
acceptance: Preserve each selected run attempt and its organization, repository, workflow, run, and attempt keys. Do not deduplicate attempts or change selected-horizon semantics.

name: repository-import-totals
subject: Count selected run attempts with matching retained imported records.
objective: Join compact run identities to already reduced event evidence, then reduce import coverage by repository.
acceptance: Match all five run-attempt keys and count each selected run row once when events are positive. Preserve optional-evidence quality and horizon filters; records for unselected runs do not establish coverage.

name: repository-run-totals
subject: Summarize distinct runs, failures, and approval-required runs by repository.
objective: Join already reduced run statistics and import coverage at repository grain.
acceptance: Group by organization and repository; preserve distinct run IDs, configured failure/action-required conclusion counts, and imported-run sums. Missing enrichment or run history must not be treated as complete coverage.
description: Distinct run and conclusion totals for each repository.

name: repository-activity-preview
subject: List repository identities before execution metrics are computed.
objective: Show retained repository identities and drill links while activity metrics are pending.
acceptance: List repositories by organization with repository drill links; this preview does not establish activity totals or outcomes.
description: Fast repository inventory with drill links; activity fields remain pending.

name: repository-activity-core
subject: Join each repository with its workflow, report, and run totals.
objective: Attach retained workflow, report, and run aggregates to each repository for bounded inventory review.
acceptance: Preserve each repository and the available joined aggregates by organization and repository; unmatched metrics remain missing evidence, not confirmed zero activity or evaluated outcomes.
description: Repository inventory joined with workflow, report, evaluation, and run totals.

name: repository-activity
subject: Show repository-level execution health, outcome activity, and AI Credit usage in an actionable inventory.
objective: Prioritize repository drill-down using declared workflows, observed runs, reports, failures, import coverage, and AIC.
acceptance: Return repository identity and link with retained counts, ingestion indicator, failure summary, AIC, and computed status; statuses describe retained evidence only, and an empty or unavailable preview cannot verify health, outcomes, or zero activity.
description: Repository-local execution health and attributed outcome totals.

name: repository-observed-run-counts
subject: Count distinct retained run IDs by repository without importing event evidence.
objective: Supply the run-volume chart without computing activity health, ingestion coverage, or workflow costs.
acceptance: Group by organization and repository coordinate and count distinct retained run IDs, not attempts; missing runs remain missing evidence and global scope and time filters still apply.

name: repository-run-inventory
subject: Registered repositories and distinct retained workflow run IDs in the selected horizon.
objective: Compare repository execution volume and choose repositories for drill-down.
acceptance: Keep up to 100 repository identities and drill links, ordered by run count descending with repository tie-breaks. Zero means no retained runs, not proof of inactivity; preserve unavailable and partial evidence. The Table view retains the full inventory.

name: workflow-route-record
subject: Project the selected workflow's identity and registration for its route shell.
objective: Identify the workflow and its recorded campaign registration before inspecting route-specific evidence.
acceptance: Preserve organization, repository, workflow identity, recorded role, activation, campaign, rollout mode, and source link; absent registration is not inferred from runs, and displayed activation does not grant execution authority.

name: workflow-runtime-health-summary
subject: Count mutually exclusive runtime conclusion classes for the selected workflow.
objective: Identify workflows whose retained run conclusions or pending execution warrant investigation.
acceptance: Within each organization, repository, and workflow, successful, failed, approval, pending, and other counts sum to the retained run total; missing or unrecognized conclusions are not treated as success, and runtime success is not a verified outcome.

name: workflow-runtime-usage-summary
subject: Sum retained AI Credits and count telemetry rows for the selected workflow without transferring runs.
objective: Inspect a workflow's observed AI Credit consumption together with the amount of retained usage telemetry.
acceptance: AI Credits sum the retained aic values within each organization, repository, and workflow, and telemetry-count counts its usage records; absent telemetry does not establish zero cost or complete run coverage.

name: outcome-route-record
subject: Project the selected safe-output record for the outcome route and its sections.
objective: Inspect a retained safe output's recorded disposition and follow its durable evidence links.
acceptance: Preserve safe-output and run identity, title, category, disposition, summary, timestamps, rollout mode, workflow context, and retained links; missing fields stay unknown and a recorded disposition is not independently verified operational impact.

name: entity-runs
subject: Project run entities for reusable run cards and workflow drill-down.
objective: Expose retained run-attempt identity, execution timing, conclusion, and link for a bounded workflow-run inspection.
acceptance: Keep organization, repository, workflow, run and attempt with status, conclusion, event, branch, duration, timestamps, and run link; missing timing or conclusion remains unknown rather than inferred success.

name: workflow-runs
subject: Project canonical runs into route-addressable workflow run evidence.
objective: Trace retained runs and recorded failure evidence for a selected workflow route.
acceptance: Preserve workflow route, run identity, start/end, status, conclusion, failure fields, mode, engine/model metadata, and run link; missing failure details do not prove success or rule out incomplete import.
description: Workflow runs with a stable repository and workflow route key.

name: workflow-failure-trend
subject: Show recent failure counts and their change for each workflow.
objective: Spot a change in observed workflow failure activity without treating unknown conclusions as failures.
acceptance: Each observed failure counts once within its own workflow; the first change is undefined and the seven-observation window is not a seven-day calendar interval.

name: workflow-reports
subject: Project retained outcomes into route-addressable workflow reports.
objective: Review retained workflow outcome reports separately from execution status before interpreting operational results.
acceptance: Keep route, safe output, report title and summary, recorded status, category, observation time, metadata, and external link; missing reports or status do not imply success or no work.
description: Workflow outcome reports with stable route keys and disposition fields.

name: audit-event-summary-buckets
subject: Aggregate high- and medium-severity audit events with the same severity and summary by workflow.
objective: Select recurring high- or medium-severity audit summaries for run-level investigation.
acceptance: Each bucket's event count is traceable to retained audit or tool observations with the same campaign, severity, workflow, and summary; missing workflow attribution stays unknown, and a count alone does not verify impact.
description: High- and medium-severity audit event counts grouped by severity, workflow, and shared summary.

name: campaign-workflows
subject: List campaign-owned orchestrator and worker workflows with database-backed execution totals.
objective: Choose an active campaign workflow whose observed execution warrants inspection.
acceptance: Listed workflows match active declared orchestrator or worker inventory entries; runs and AI Credits agree with the selected-horizon inventory, and absence is not evidence of disabled authority or no executions. Rollout mode is context, not permission to change policy.
description: Campaign workflows projected from lean canonical inventory, with shared declaration names and active-only workflow drill-down links.

name: campaign-repository-declarations
subject: List active declared campaign workflows and their owning repositories without execution evidence.
objective: Inspect campaign repository topology without computing unused run totals or import coverage.
acceptance: Preserve active orchestrator and worker identities, display names, rollout context, links, and ordering. Declaration counts are not target enrollment, dispatch coverage, or execution totals. Empty inventory and unavailable workflow evidence remain distinct.
description: Declaration-only repository topology. Run totals and import-evidence quality belong to execution views, not this inventory.

name: campaign-repository-inventory
subject: Present declared campaign repository topology in workflow display order.
objective: Filter and search projected repository coordinates and workflow names without time-filtering structural declarations.
acceptance: Preserve the campaign workflow list's stable ordering and declaration-only evidence quality; runtime horizons must not remove declared workflows.

name: campaign-reports
subject: Project retained outcomes into campaign-addressable report evidence.
objective: Identify a campaign report whose durable outcome record needs follow-up.
acceptance: Each report's campaign, title, source link, observation time, and disposition match its retained outcome; missing status is labeled unknown rather than accepted or resolved, and report production is not verified impact.
description: Campaign outcome reports with database-backed disposition fields.

name: campaign-worker-issues
subject: Project issue outcomes created by campaign worker workflows.
objective: Choose a campaign worker issue whose current recorded disposition needs review.
acceptance: Include only issues whose producing run joins declared worker inventory on organization, repository, and workflow, even when the issue lands elsewhere. Preserve campaign and role across Activity imports. Retain run and status evidence; missing closure details stay unknown and closure is not proof of resolution.
description: Campaign-addressable issue outcomes restricted to declared worker workflows.

name: campaign-issue-tab-counts
subject: Count the retained worker issues available for each campaign Reports tab.
objective: Decide whether a campaign has retained worker issue reports to inspect.
acceptance: For each returned campaign, items equals the number of rows in campaign-worker-issues for that campaign in the same horizon; missing campaigns are not treated as zero issues or verified resolution.
description: One campaign row with the number of retained issue outcomes produced by campaign workers.

name: campaign-readme-orchestrators
subject: Resolve one repository link for each campaign README from its declared orchestrator workflow.
objective: Locate the declared orchestrator repository to contextualize a campaign README.
acceptance: Each returned campaign and repository link traces to a declared orchestrator workflow; missing or multiple declarations are reported as uncertain rather than inventing a canonical repository.

name: campaign-readme-details
subject: Present retained campaign README content with its repository-relative link context.
objective: Open the campaign's retained README in its declared repository context before relying on its guidance.
acceptance: The README text and path match the campaign record and any repository link resolves through a declared orchestrator; absent content or repository linkage remains unavailable, not inferred.

name: campaign-memory-campaigns
subject: Provide the registered campaigns whose repository memory can be browsed together.
objective: Choose a registered campaign for repository-memory inspection.
acceptance: Each campaign identity and display name matches the retained campaign registry in the selected scope; listing a campaign does not establish that memory observations exist or are complete.
description: Registered campaigns ordered for the all-campaign repository-memory browser.

name: campaign-performance-baseline-totals
subject: Establish a selected-horizon campaign baseline from concluded run attempts while keeping reliability, unverified production, and efficiency as separate facts.
objective: Select campaigns whose retained run reliability, output production, or AI Credit efficiency merits closer examination.
acceptance: Concluded and successful attempts, outputs, and mean AI Credits reconcile to filtered retained runs; absent denominators or costs stay unknown. Produced outputs are unverified, not operational value.
description: Canonical campaign run attempts aggregated into bounded selected-horizon baseline totals without treating runtime success or produced outputs as operational value.

name: campaign-performance-baseline
subject: Turn each campaign's selected-horizon baseline totals into deterministic reliability and production signals with an explicit successful-run efficiency fact.
objective: Decide which campaign baseline signal needs run- or output-level verification next.
acceptance: Success-rate and signal labels follow the retained totals and their explicit denominators; no concluded attempts or output evidence is distinguished from zero verified impact, and AI Credits per successful run remain a separate cost fact rather than a value score.
description: A bounded, explainable baseline that distinguishes runtime reliability, unverified output production, and AI Credit efficiency.

name: campaign-problem-runs
subject: List retained failed runs for campaign problem investigation.
objective: Choose a recent failed campaign run to investigate with its diagnostic evidence.
acceptance: Each row corresponds to a retained campaign run with a declared failure, startup-failure, stale, or timed-out status; campaign-problem-run-evidence orders matching rows newest first. Absence is not proof of healthy execution or complete ingestion.
description: Private failed-run input with retained diagnostic metadata; the evidence consumer orders only runs matching current runtime problems.

name: campaign-problem-runtime-failures
subject: Select current failing runtime partitions without presentation ordering.
objective: Retain the exact current-failure eligibility needed by the problem evidence join.
acceptance: A latest failure streak is a nonnegative integer, so failure-count at least one is equivalent to has-current-failure; missing or incomplete runtime evidence remains unknown.
description: Private unsorted failure partitions for problem evidence; ordering is supplied by the retained failed runs.

name: campaign-problem-runtime-partitions
subject: Project current runtime problem keys and diagnoses for the failed-run evidence join.
objective: Avoid sorting and retaining unused runtime problem presentation fields.
acceptance: Retain both current failures and unobserved orchestrators, including their metadata and duplicate-key failure semantics; this projection does not establish health or root cause.
description: Private compact equivalent of campaign-runtime-problems for equality enrichment, not presentation.

name: campaign-problem-run-evidence
subject: Attach the current campaign runtime problem summary to each retained failed Run for that partition.
objective: Inspect the failure count and problem kind alongside a failed run without inferring its root cause.
acceptance: Each returned row joins a retained failed run to a runtime problem on campaign, workflow, and runtime repository; the inner join drops unmatched runs, so compare with campaign-problem-runs before interpreting absence as no problem.
description: Failed campaign runs annotated with the failure-count and problem-kind of their active runtime problem, one row per retained failed Run.

name: campaign-problem-latest-target-runs
subject: Identify the most recent retained failed Run for each campaign workflow target repository.
objective: Select the latest retained failed run identity for each campaign workflow and target partition.
acceptance: For every returned campaign, workflow, runtime repository, and target repository, latest-target-run agrees with the maximum retained failed run identity in that partition; a missing partition is not a healthy target.
description: One row per campaign workflow and target repository with its most recent retained failed Run identity.

name: campaign-problem-error-groups
subject: Cluster retained failed Run evidence by workflow, runtime repository, target repository, and error signature so repeated identical failures for one target collapse into one diagnosable group.
objective: Rank repeated target-specific error signatures for investigation without merging unrelated failures.
acceptance: Occurrence-count and latest-run match retained failed runs grouped by campaign, workflow, repositories, problem kind, and signature; unknown signatures may group together. Counts do not prove a root cause.
description: One row per distinct target repository and error signature within a campaign runtime problem partition, with an occurrence count and the most recent matching Run identity for follow-up.

name: campaign-current-problem-error-groups
subject: Keep only the newest error signature for each campaign workflow target repository.
objective: Focus investigation on the signature associated with the latest retained failed run per target.
acceptance: Each returned group joins campaign-problem-latest-target-runs on campaign, workflow, runtime repository, and latest run ID; target repository is not a join key, so verify target identity against underlying runs before claiming one current signature per target.
description: Current target-specific error groups whose representative Run is the target repository's most recent retained failed Run.

name: campaign-problem-items
subject: Attach the most recent representative Run evidence to each distinct campaign runtime problem error signature.
objective: Open the representative failed run and target for each current campaign problem group.
acceptance: Check joined run-link, run ID, campaign, workflow, and runtime repository; verify target against run evidence (not a join key). Unobserved orchestrators need inventory review. Missing evidence remains unknown; rollout mode does not authorize policy changes.
description: Current campaign runtime problems represented by the newest error signature for each target repository, with its effective rollout mode, an occurrence count, the most recent matching failed Run, and a repair prompt.

name: campaign-problem-tab-counts
subject: Count the current runtime problem items available for each campaign Problems tab.
objective: Determine whether the campaign has current retained failure groups requiring review.
acceptance: For every returned campaign, items equals the number of campaign-problem-items rows in the same horizon; a missing count does not establish zero failures or healthy execution.
description: One campaign row with the number of current runtime problem groups.

name: operational-value-plot-series
subject: One primary outcome plot per repository, optional campaign, workflow and native measure.
objective: Keep every finite value visible and move provenance to individual observations.
acceptance: Separate unlike units and directions. Preserve evaluator, maturity and cadence on points. Connect only adjacent points with known matching context and declared cadence; never infer a combined trend or baseline.

args.value: Recorded measurements, not a combined trend or a verified impact assessment.

name: operational-value-period-observations
subject: Exact native measurement periods and frozen evaluator identities.
objective: Keep measurement duration, cadence, analysis endpoint and adoption context separate.
acceptance: Use only declared period boundaries and coverage. Never infer legacy metadata or turn the display horizon into an evidence window.

name: operational-value-period-latest
subject: Latest assessment of each exact measurement period.
objective: Do not resurrect an older accepted value when the same period has a newer unavailable assessment.
acceptance: Deduplicate before checking coverage or maturity. Preserve null values and missing metadata.

name: operational-value-complete-period-candidates
subject: Complete mature reference periods.
objective: Require accepted evidence for a recent comparison rather than arbitrary older observations.
acceptance: Only explicitly complete mature periods can serve as references. Missing periods remain missing.

name: operational-value-complete-periods
subject: Complete reference evidence available by the analysis endpoint.
objective: Prevent future reference corrections from changing a historical comparison.
acceptance: A future latest assessment withholds the reference; never resurrect an older accepted correction.

name: operational-value-comparable-history
subject: Native change between adjacent equal-duration measurement periods.
objective: Compare non-overlapping intervals or snapshot cutoffs under one evaluator, independently of adoption classification.
acceptance: The reference ends exactly at the current start, with the same duration, cadence, native unit, direction and evaluator. No overlapping daily rolling comparison or substitution across a gap.

name: operational-value-movements
subject: Direction-aware movement of retained primary repository measures.
objective: Classify native changes without averaging unlike measures.
acceptance: Movement requires current complete mature periods, a known evaluator, native unit, increase/decrease direction and an adjacent equal-duration reference. Expose cohort and exposure changes; no sustained-trend, statistical or causal claim.

args.value: Aggregate movement is not proof of within-cohort improvement.
Eligible cohort changed or its identity was not retained; inspect workload mix.
Cutoff-state change, not a count of remediations.

name: operational-value-ordered-history
subject: Latest observation of each repository measure, before maturity or value filtering.
objective: Prevent an older positive or mature result from masking a newer incomplete observation.
acceptance: Order by measurement cutoff, then assessment timestamp and stable ID. Historical corrections cannot replace a newer measurement period. Missing period metadata falls back to assessment time and remains incomparable. Preserve native zero and null.

name: operational-value-latest
subject: Latest primary outcome per campaign, repository and measure.
objective: Expose the latest retained movement, including incomplete evidence.
acceptance: Latest selection precedes aggregation. Older mature or positive observations cannot mask newer incomplete evidence.

name: operational-value-repository-evidence-order
subject: Identify oldest and newest latest primary evidence per repository.
objective: Expose date bounds across the latest retained primary measures for a repository.
acceptance: Partition by repository, retaining all input rows. Identify first rows in ascending and descending observation order, with ID tie-breaks. Do not infer freshness or fill gaps.

name: operational-value-repository-counts
subject: Latest primary movement counts per repository across campaigns and standalone workflows.
objective: Summarize comparable and missing primary-measure evidence without combining native values.
acceptance: Group by repository; count goals and improving, worsening and unchanged measures. Preserve oldest/newest retained dates. Incomparable goals remain in the total, not in comparable counts.

name: operational-value-repository-signals
subject: One conservative direction signal per repository across all workflow outcomes.
objective: Rank repository investigations while preserving disagreement and evidence gaps.
acceptance: Any incomparable primary measure makes the repository insufficient; opposing comparable measures are Mixed. Count each repository once.

name: operational-value-repository-subjects
subject: Inventory and measured repositories, independent of campaign membership.
objective: Include standalone workflow outcomes and unmeasured inventory repositories.
acceptance: Deduplicate organization/repository identities. Observations outside campaign inventory remain visible; missing measurements are not zero value.

name: operational-value-repository-coverage
subject: Outcome evidence coverage for each repository.
objective: Expose measurement gaps without requiring campaign registration.
acceptance: One row per repository. Count latest primary goals, not reports. Preserve conservative direction and comparison blockers; no evidence is not zero value.

name: operational-value-overview-totals
subject: Repository measurement availability and latest comparable goal counts.
objective: Explain evidence readiness before repository drill-down.
acceptance: Count repositories once across campaigns and standalone workflows. Goal counts describe latest primary measurements, not impact.

name: operational-value-overview-summary
subject: Compact portfolio measurement readiness summary.
objective: Explain comparison readiness without replacing unavailable movement with zero value.
acceptance: Preserve repository and latest goal totals; distinguish no observations from measurements without comparable movement.

args.value: Inspect repository movement and comparison gaps below.
Measurements are available, but none supports a comparable movement yet. Inspect the reasons below.
No primary measurements are retained. Inspect collection and measurement coverage in Evidence; absence is not zero value.

name: operational-value-measured-repositories
subject: Repositories with retained primary outcome measurements.
objective: Choose a repository directly, including standalone workflow outcomes.
acceptance: One repository card across all campaigns and standalone workflows. Preserve disagreement and missing comparison evidence.

name: operational-value-unmeasured-repositories
subject: Inventory repositories without retained primary measurements.
objective: Inspect evidence gaps without implying absent contracts or zero value.
acceptance: Keep every unmeasured inventory repository; no campaign is required.

name: operational-value-direction-repositories
subject: Comparable outcome direction per repository.
objective: Inspect repository movement without combining native values.
acceptance: One count per fully comparable repository. Opposing goals remain Mixed; absent evidence is not neutral. Links open repository history directly.

name: campaign-baseline-successful-runs
subject: Project successful concluded attempts from the selected-horizon campaign baseline.
objective: Show the successful share of concluded runs without implying verified impact.
acceptance: Counts reconcile to campaign-performance-baseline-totals; missing campaigns do not imply zero runs.

name: campaign-baseline-other-runs
subject: Project non-successful concluded attempts from the selected-horizon campaign baseline.
objective: Show the remaining concluded runs for reliability review.
acceptance: Runs equal concluded-runs minus successful-runs; the category includes every other concluded status, not just failures.

name: campaign-baseline-outcome-distribution
subject: Compare successful and other concluded attempts in the selected horizon.
objective: Spot campaign run reliability that needs inspection.
acceptance: Successful and other counts sum to concluded attempts; neither runtime result nor output production establishes operational value.

name: campaign-audit-summary-plot-inventory
subject: Describe the rendered audit-summary chart using the shared campaign Insights plot contract.
objective: Find campaigns with retained high- or medium-severity audit summaries worth reviewing.
acceptance: Each campaign's bucket count equals its retained audit-event-summary-buckets rows; the count describes displayed groups, not distinct incidents or confirmed harm, and missing buckets are not proof of safety.
description: One plot-inventory row per campaign when its high- and medium-severity audit summary chart has data.

name: campaign-insight-plot-inventory
subject: Inventory every plot rendered on each campaign Insights page through one reusable plot contract.
objective: Choose an available campaign Insights plot to inspect its underlying evidence.
acceptance: Each plot entry is supplied by the audit summary plot inventory for the same campaign; experimental operational-value evidence is excluded, no plot count is treated as outcome quality, and unavailable evidence is not synthesized into a plot.
description: One campaign row per rendered Insights plot, independent of the plot's data source or renderer.

name: campaign-insight-tab-counts
subject: Count the plots declared by the shared campaign Insights plot inventory.
objective: Determine whether a campaign has evidence-backed Insights plots to inspect.
acceptance: For every returned campaign, items equals its rows in campaign-insight-plot-inventory for the same horizon; absent rows do not establish absent value, and plot counts do not measure impact.
description: One campaign row with the number of rendered Insights plots, independent of plot type.

name: workflow-ordered-runs
subject: Order retained run attempts within each workflow by their observed start time.
objective: Identify each workflow's latest execution without importing event coverage or outcome totals.
acceptance: The first chronological attempt in each workflow partition has no preceding run delta; break timestamp ties by run ID and attempt, and use creation time for queued runs.

name: workflow-latest-runs
subject: Project the latest retained run attempt for each workflow.
objective: Expose each workflow's latest observed execution state without implying aggregate outcomes.
acceptance: Select only the first chronologically ordered attempt per workflow; preserve queued and in-progress states instead of treating unknown conclusions as failures.

name: workflow-list-preview
subject: Show workflow declarations while latest-run evidence is still loading.
objective: Make workflow identities and drill links available before retained runs are evaluated.
acceptance: Preserve every declared workflow and its drill link; leave latest-run fields absent until the complete projection arrives.

name: workflow-list
subject: List declared workflows in latest observed run order.
objective: Open a dedicated workflow page from a lightweight inventory with its latest execution status.
acceptance: Preserve textual run identities and keep unobserved workflows last with an explicit missing-run state; use only workflow declarations and retained runs, not event coverage or aggregate success/failure counters.

name: runs-daily-conclusions
subject: Aggregate workflow run conclusions by UTC day for the Runs stacked area graph.
objective: Expose changes in observed run conclusions by day for investigation.
acceptance: Count retained runs by started-at UTC day and recorded conclusion; an empty day or missing conclusion is not evidence of healthy execution or absence of activity.

name: entity-events
subject: Project all run-owned records for reusable cards and run drill-down.
objective: Expose run-owned event identity, status, provenance, timestamp, and available navigation links for inspection.
acceptance: Projected event fields and fallback URL trace to the source record; a missing link or event is not proof of no output, and event status alone does not verify downstream impact.

name: runs-table
subject: Show observed workflow runs in a table with execution, repository, workflow, engine, model, and navigation details.
objective: Locate observed runs whose recorded status or conclusion needs closer inspection.
acceptance: Show recorded run identity, status, conclusion, scope, execution metadata, and source links in newest-first order; absent runs require a freshness and coverage check, and a successful run is not proof of accepted outcomes.
description: Observed workflow runs ordered from newest to oldest.

name: workflow-aic-per-run
subject: List declared workflows with recorded positive AI Credit costs and their average cost per run.
objective: Identify workflows with observed run AIC averages worth investigating alongside run evidence.
acceptance: Include only declared workflows with at least one run attempt reporting positive AIC; exclude zero and missing telemetry from the average and ranking, without interpreting missing telemetry as free execution.
description: Workflow AI Credit averages limited to run attempts with recorded positive AIC.

name: dashboard-ingestion-health
subject: Expose the current collection state for the global ingestion indicator.
objective: Distinguish reported ingestion failure or recovery from the age of retained workflow evidence.
acceptance: Use the authorized server collection-health classification, not cumulative failures or browser refresh time. Missing or unauthorized health remains unknown and static dashboards do not request this source.

name: dashboard-data-freshness
subject: Find the newest workflow activity timestamp in retained canonical data.
objective: Warn globally when the ingested workflow evidence has not advanced for 24 hours.
acceptance: Use upstream updated-at, falling back to created-at, never browser import or refresh time. Missing or invalid timestamps remain unknown; inactivity alone does not prove an ingestion failure.

name: indexing-shards
subject: List retained Activity shard import receipts.
objective: Inspect which shards were ingested, when, and how many records they committed.
acceptance: Show shard scope, phase, import status, import timestamp, counts and payload identity from retained receipts. Import time is not upstream freshness and missing receipts do not prove complete coverage.

name: ingestion-queued
subject: Label the shared collection task queue depth for the administrator queue chart.
objective: Identify total ready and scheduled collection work, including backfill tasks.
acceptance: Show the observed shared queue depth only when collection is configured; missing or unauthorized health data is not zero pending work.

name: ingestion-inflight
subject: Label current in-flight collection tasks for the administrator queue chart.
objective: Distinguish leased collection tasks from work awaiting collection.
acceptance: Show the observed pending task count only when collection is configured; do not infer a count from an unavailable source.

name: ingestion-backfill
subject: Label cumulative backfill run admissions for the administrator ingestion chart.
objective: Compare historically admitted run tasks with current outstanding work without treating admissions as a live backlog.
acceptance: Show the cumulative run task admissions only when collection is configured; this value does not decrease as tasks complete and missing health data does not imply completed backfill.

name: ingestion-queue-sizes
subject: Compare current shared queue pressure, in-flight tasks, and cumulative historical backfill admissions from the administrator-only server snapshot.
objective: Spot a growing backlog without treating past backfill admissions as outstanding work.
acceptance: Current queue sizes and cumulative admissions come only from an authorized collection-health snapshot; unavailable state is not zero.

name: ingestion-health
subject: Show the current Redis-backed webhook and collection health snapshot.
objective: Determine whether the reported collection, webhook, queue, and backfill state warrants inspecting ingestion diagnostics.
acceptance: Report the observed health, queue, failure, success, and projection timestamps together; verify freshness and configuration before calling collection healthy, and treat missing state as unknown rather than zero.

name: github-api-usage
subject: Show retained GitHub API quota usage per bucket and in aggregate over the last 24 hours.
objective: Determine whether any GitHub App installation or the CAO fleet as a whole is approaching its GitHub API rate limit.
acceptance: Report peak usage percentages with their limits, used, and reserved counts; treat a slot without observations as unknown rather than idle, and never infer credentials from bucket identity.

name: marketplace-package-detail
subject: Expose normalized marketplace package records for source-coordinate lookup by the detail view.
objective: Locate the resolver-produced package record for a source coordinate supplied by the consuming view.
acceptance: Use the returned package-source, registry, ref, and resolved-commit fields when inspecting a matching record; the query itself does not filter by coordinate, and an absent match is not proof of package nonexistence or approval.

name: friction-by-workflow
subject: Rank workflows by observed gh-aw audit friction AI Credit totals for investigation.
objective: Identify which repository and workflow combinations have the largest measured friction totals in retained observations.
acceptance: Compare friction-aic and distinct runs with the underlying measurement states and attribution evidence; do not equate a ranking with avoidable cost or a validated saving.
description: Total gh-aw audit friction cost grouped by repository and workflow.

name: friction-observations
subject: List retained gh-aw audit friction measurements with their run context and attribution totals.
objective: Trace each reported friction measurement to a run and distinguish counted, suppressed, and unattributed occurrences.
acceptance: Preserve native AIC, total-run AIC, measurement state, timestamps, links, and occurrence counts; missing or unattributed evidence remains uncertain, not a verified opportunity for savings.
description: Newest friction measurements first, preserving the native audit values and uncertainty state.

name: indexing-shard-dates
subject: Read the activity date encoded in each retained transaction's shard filename.
objective: Separate source shard dates from ingestion timestamps.
acceptance: Keep every transaction and leave absent, invalid, or structural shard dates unknown; never substitute import time.

name: indexing-ingestion-runs
subject: Show retained ingestion transactions at the activity date encoded in their shard filename.
objective: Compare reported run counts by source shard activity date, independently of import time.
acceptance: Preserve every dated transaction, including coincident dates, all kinds, and zero counts, without grouping, limits, or page filters. Omit missing or invalid shard dates; never substitute import time. Missing counts use labeled zero-position placeholders, not measured zeroes.

name: indexing-campaigns-table-count
subject: Count retained campaigns rows in the dashboard database.
objective: Provide the retained campaigns row count for the table-count diagnostic.
acceptance: Label the result campaigns and count campaign rows in the current database; absence or zero does not establish completeness or expected campaign coverage.

name: indexing-repositories-table-count
subject: Count retained repositories rows in the dashboard database.
objective: Provide the retained repositories row count for the table-count diagnostic.
acceptance: Label the result repositories and count repository rows in the current database; absence or zero does not establish completeness or expected repository coverage.

name: indexing-workflows-table-count
subject: Count retained workflows rows in the dashboard database.
objective: Provide the retained workflows row count for the table-count diagnostic.
acceptance: Label the result workflows and count workflow rows in the current database; absence or zero does not establish completeness or expected workflow coverage.

name: indexing-runs-table-count
subject: Count retained workflow runs rows in the dashboard database.
objective: Provide the retained workflow runs row count for the table-count diagnostic.
acceptance: Label the result workflow runs and count run rows in the current database; absence or zero does not establish completeness or expected execution volume.

name: indexing-domains-table-count
subject: Count retained network domains rows in the dashboard database.
objective: Provide the retained network domains row count for the table-count diagnostic.
acceptance: Label the result network domains and count domain event rows in the current database; absence or zero does not prove no network activity.

name: indexing-tools-table-count
subject: Count retained tool events rows in the dashboard database.
objective: Provide the retained tool events row count for the table-count diagnostic.
acceptance: Label the result tool events and count tool event rows in the current database; absence or zero does not prove no tool use.

name: indexing-audits-table-count
subject: Count retained audit events rows in the dashboard database.
objective: Provide the retained audit events row count for the table-count diagnostic.
acceptance: Label the result audit events and count audit event rows in the current database; absence or zero does not prove no audit findings.

name: indexing-issues-table-count
subject: Count retained issue events rows in the dashboard database.
objective: Provide the retained issue events row count for the table-count diagnostic.
acceptance: Label the result issue events and count issue event rows in the current database; absence or zero does not prove no issues exist.

name: indexing-operational-values-table-count
subject: Count retained operational values rows in the dashboard database.
objective: Provide the retained operational values row count for the table-count diagnostic.
acceptance: Label the result operational values and count operational-value rows in the current database; absence or zero does not imply zero value or an evaluated outcome.

name: indexing-transactions-table-count
subject: Count retained ingestion transactions rows in the dashboard database.
objective: Provide the retained ingestion transactions row count for the table-count diagnostic.
acceptance: Label the result ingestion transactions and count transaction IDs in the current database; absence or zero does not establish whether upstream ingestion ran.

name: indexing-database-table-counts
subject: Count retained canonical dashboard database rows by table.
objective: Compare the retained table row counts to identify tables needing further ingestion or coverage investigation.
acceptance: Union the named table-count projections and report their table labels and counts; check source availability, retention, and separate transaction evidence before interpreting an empty or small table as an ingestion defect.

name: indexing-transactions
subject: Prepare retained ingestion transactions for card presentation.
objective: Expose transaction identity, kind, timestamp, committed-record count, and payload hash for ingestion traceability.
acceptance: Projected fields match retained transactions without implying successful upstream coverage from a committed count or hash alone; missing transactions require a freshness and availability check.

name: engines-models-usage
subject: Summarize run-level AIC and token usage by agent and model identifiers without treating unavailable telemetry as zero.
objective: Locate agent and model combinations whose observed per-run AIC or token usage merits checking against individual runs.
acceptance: Report run counts and native minimum, mean, and maximum values only for reported metrics; inspect underlying runs for per-metric telemetry coverage and context before comparing combinations, and infer neither efficiency nor outcome value from usage alone.
description: Observed workflow runs grouped by agent ID and model ID. AIC statistics use only positive-AIC runs; token statistics use runs that reported each token metric.

name: skill-invocations
subject: Select observed skill invocations for skill usage analytics.
objective: Expose skill event identity, scope, invocation counts, and failed counts for downstream usage analysis.
acceptance: Keep each observed event and its repository/workflow attribution with native counts; missing records or failed counts alone do not establish whether a skill was useful or available.

name: skill-invocations-by-skill
subject: Rank skills by their observed invocation count.
objective: Identify skills with the highest observed invocation totals for follow-up inspection.
acceptance: Sum observed invocation counts by skill and retain the rank as a usage description; do not equate popularity with effectiveness or infer unobserved invocations.

name: skill-invocations-by-workflow-totals
subject: Rank workflows by their observed skill invocation count.
objective: Produce repository-scoped workflow invocation totals for downstream skill-usage comparison.
acceptance: Sum observed invocation counts by organization, repository, and workflow; totals describe recorded usage only, not success or expected adoption.

name: skill-invocations-by-workflow
subject: Present workflow skill invocation totals with drill-through navigation to the workflow dashboard.
objective: Expose observed workflow skill invocation totals with a link to inspect each workflow.
acceptance: Each projected workflow coordinate, link, and invocation total traces to the grouped source; using a link to investigate does not establish that usage caused an outcome.

name: skill-workflow-totals
subject: Count observed invocations for each skill and workflow.
objective: Produce skill-by-workflow invocation totals for the downstream inventory.
acceptance: Sum observed invocation counts by skill, organization, repository, and workflow; missing combinations are not evidence that a skill could not run.

name: skill-workflow-inventory
subject: List observed skills by workflow with drill-through navigation to the workflow dashboard.
objective: Identify observed skill/workflow combinations and provide a workflow link for inspecting their runs.
acceptance: Show the repository, workflow, skill, link, and observed invocation total from the grouped evidence; an absent row does not prove non-use, and a high count does not prove effectiveness.

name: experiment-assignment-coverage
subject: Count observed run assignments for each experiment and workflow without inferring a completion target.
objective: Expose assignment counts by experiment and workflow for investigating observed experiment coverage.
acceptance: Count retained assignment rows in each experiment/workflow group, not distinct runs; do not invent a target, infer missing assignments from absent groups, or treat assignments as eval or grader outcomes.

name: eval-status-ledger
subject: Inspect every explicitly classified eval answer, including UNKNOWN.
objective: Expose retained eval observations with their workflow, run evidence and observation time.
acceptance: Keep recorded YES, NO and UNKNOWN answers distinct; unknown or absent evidence must not imply success or failure, and historical answers are not current verdicts or validated operational outcomes.

name: eval-answer-counts
subject: Count recorded YES, NO and UNKNOWN answers for each workflow-scoped eval.
objective: Provide complete answer denominators before expanding each eval into three bars.
acceptance: Keep canonical eval identities separate and count only explicitly classified observations. Select at most 33 complete eval groups, never truncate an answer group.

name: eval-yes-shares
subject: Compute the YES share of each eval's recorded answers.
objective: Expose recorded YES proportions for comparing answer categories without inferring verified operational outcomes.
acceptance: Emit one YES row per retained canonical eval group, including zero YES counts; answer-share is yes / answers across recorded YES, NO and UNKNOWN observations. Do not count absent observations.

name: eval-no-shares
subject: Compute the NO share of each eval's recorded answers.
objective: Expose recorded NO proportions for comparing answer categories without treating historical answers as current verdicts.
acceptance: Emit one NO row per retained canonical eval group, including zero NO counts; answer-share is no / answers across recorded YES, NO and UNKNOWN observations. Do not count absent observations.

name: eval-unknown-shares
subject: Compute the explicit UNKNOWN share of each eval's recorded answers.
objective: Expose explicitly recorded UNKNOWN proportions without conflating absent observations with classified uncertainty.
acceptance: Emit one UNKNOWN row per retained canonical eval group, including zero UNKNOWN counts; answer-share is unknown / answers across recorded YES, NO and UNKNOWN observations. Missing observations are not UNKNOWN answers.

name: eval-answer-distribution
subject: Compare YES, NO and UNKNOWN percentages within each eval.
objective: Show three horizontal bars per eval that together account for all recorded answers.
acceptance: Emit all three answer categories, including zero shares; percentages sum to 100 per canonical eval. Missing observations are not UNKNOWN answers. Preserve workflow and repository attribution.

name: grader-observed-maxima
subject: Find each workflow-scoped grader's maximum retained value in the selected data.
objective: Provide an observed normalization denominator without mixing grader identities or claiming a theoretical maximum.
acceptance: Group by canonical grader identity, not display name; ignore missing values and preserve zero or negative maxima without substituting a denominator.

name: grader-normalized-observations
subject: Normalize each grader observation by that grader's observed maximum.
objective: Compare relative grader values over time while preserving native measurements and run provenance.
acceptance: Compute value / max-grader-value without clamping or inverting lower-is-better measures; zero or missing denominators produce null, never a fabricated zero or infinity.

name: grader-value-scatter
subject: Plot timed grader observations with a defined value-to-observed-maximum ratio.
objective: Show relative grader measurements at their recorded observation times.
acceptance: Keep each eligible observation and its run link; omit missing ratios or observation times from the plot while retaining those records in the native-value ledger. Ratios are not eval answers or evidence of improvement.

name: grader-status-ledger
subject: Report grader measurements, units and explicit statuses without confusing them with binary eval answers.
