objective: Preserve numeric grader evidence and distinguish explicit per-observation pass and fail verdicts from unknown statuses.
acceptance: Retain native grader values, units and statuses. Map only pass/passed to YES and fail/failed to NO in the auxiliary verdict field, leaving all other statuses unknown; never infer an eval answer, current success, causation or policy authority from a grader score.

name: routing-session-observations
subject: Read metadata-only unified-session routing evidence.
objective: Keep routing analytics independent of native logs and inferred run totals.
acceptance: Only recognized session events contribute; event clocks remain absent when unrecorded.

name: routing-session-attempts
subject: Identify available session files and their earliest recorded clocks.
objective: Keep rerun attempts from multiplying routing denominators.
acceptance: Attempt order is only a tie-breaker after the recorded session clock.

name: routing-session-order
subject: Order duplicate run sessions by run time and attempt.
objective: Keep the latest file for each repository/run identity.
acceptance: Only one attempt contributes to routing facts.

name: routing-latest-sessions
subject: Retain one authoritative session attempt per run.
objective: Avoid mixing picks or accounting from reruns.
acceptance: Duplicate attempts remain available in session coverage.

name: routing-session-events
subject: Read routing metadata from the latest session file per run.
objective: Deduplicate rerun attempts before any metric.
acceptance: Earlier attempts never add cost or change the selected pick.

name: routing-run-facts
subject: Collect per-session source facts without interpreting absence as success.
objective: Resolve routing states and coverage from runner and proxy evidence.
acceptance: Agent-phase proxy selection wins over failure and harness status; untimed observations keep unknown time.

name: routing-duplicate-sessions
subject: Count session attempts omitted from routing metrics.
objective: Expose duplicate files instead of silently summing them.
acceptance: Only nonauthoritative attempts contribute.

name: routing-coverage
subject: Expose supported, legacy, unsupported and unidentified session coverage.
objective: Keep sessions excluded from adoption denominators visible.
acceptance: Missing identity or time is never inferred from external run success.

name: routing-ordered-selections
subject: Order proxy selections within each session.
objective: Use the last selection by normalized clock and file order.
acceptance: Harness and advisory picks never override proxy selections.

name: routing-selections
subject: Retain one authoritative proxy pick per run.
objective: Avoid multiplying requests or run counts after re-selection.
acceptance: One row per identified run uses the final proxy selection.

name: routing-resolved-runs
subject: Resolve routing state, pick and label cells from unified sessions.
objective: Distinguish selected, failed, harness-only, configured, inferred and unknown evidence.
acceptance: Proxy evidence wins; configuration conflicts are visible; missing picks and time remain unknown.

name: routing-filter-candidates
subject: Apply one run-level scope before every routing metric and event join.
objective: Filter complete sessions, never fragments of their evidence.
acceptance: Unknown run time is excluded from a bounded range; blank filters retain all known values.

name: routing-runs
subject: Retain identified runs matching every selected routing filter.
objective: Use the same population for adoption, accounting and outcomes.
acceptance: A time bound excludes untimed runs and does not remove individual events from retained sessions.

name: routing-events
subject: Retain all evidence belonging to scoped identified runs.
objective: Filter event metrics by the resolved run rather than by individual event clocks.
acceptance: State, pick and accounting are computed before the scope is applied.

name: routing-adoption
subject: Count identified sessions by routing state and engine.
objective: Show adoption without silently treating unknown or inferred routing as explicit configuration.
acceptance: All seven states remain distinct and sum to identified sessions.

name: routing-adoption-totals
subject: Count routed populations and classifier coverage by engine.
objective: Exclude unknown state from adoption shares without hiding it.
acceptance: Configured-unrecorded counts as routed; inferred unrouted stays separate.

name: routing-adoption-summary
subject: Show adoption and degraded-classification shares with their denominators.
objective: Distinguish unknown coverage from explicit zero.
acceptance: A missing or zero denominator produces no ratio.

name: routing-decision-dimensions
subject: Group selected runs by configured and resolved objectives.
objective: Expose configured mode independently of the router's resolved mode.
acceptance: Absent goal, mode and classifier fields remain unknown.

name: routing-picks
subject: Compare selected picks within classifier label cells.
objective: Separate task variation from routing decisions.
acceptance: Only proxy-selected runs contribute and absent labels remain unknown.

name: routing-pick-history
subject: Order known picks within workflow and classifier label cells.
objective: Separate task variation from pick instability.
acceptance: Unknown picks and untimed runs cannot establish adjacent changes.

name: routing-pick-changes
subject: Mark decidable adjacent pick changes.
objective: Exclude first observations from change-rate denominators.
acceptance: Label-conditioned pairs never compare unlike classifier cells.

name: routing-stability-totals
subject: Count adjacent changes and distinct picks per workflow.
objective: Measure stability with explicit pair denominators.
acceptance: Label-conditioned change rate weights cells by their adjacent pairs.

name: routing-pick-frequencies
subject: Count each known pick within its workflow.
objective: Compute modal share without counting unknown picks.
acceptance: All retained known picks contribute, including runs without an event clock.

name: routing-modal-picks
subject: Count known picks and the largest workflow pick cohort.
objective: Distinguish modal stability from adjacent change rates.
acceptance: Modal share uses runs with known model and effort only.

name: routing-stability
subject: Compute observed workflow and label-conditioned pick change rates.
objective: Distinguish changing tasks from changing decisions.
acceptance: Fewer than two comparable runs produces an unknown rate.

name: routing-phase-sources
subject: Choose one nonoverlapping accounting source per run and phase.
objective: Prefer proxy token usage over usage reports.
acceptance: Snapshot totals and cumulative totalAic never enter additive cost.

name: routing-accounting-candidates
subject: Read nonoverlapping per-response accounting records.
objective: Expose recorded credits and token classes without repricing unknown usage.
acceptance: Each phase uses proxy accounting when present and usage.report otherwise; absent AIC is counted.

name: routing-accounting
subject: Select the authoritative accounting source for each phase.
objective: Exclude overlapping usage reports and snapshots.
acceptance: Every accounting row contributes at most once.

name: routing-request-candidates
subject: Keep per-request routing decisions separate from accounting.
objective: Join routed outcomes by run, phase and request ID.
acceptance: Rejected requests establish local zero cost; other unmatched requests retain unknown cost.

name: routing-request-records
subject: Retain the latest record for each request identity.
objective: Avoid duplicate request joins and overlapping totals.
acceptance: Requests without IDs remain independent, not falsely correlated.

name: routing-subagent-candidates
subject: Read engine-reported sub-agent request ownership.
objective: Use exact request-ID ownership before falling back to unsplit traffic.
acceptance: Only request identities can assign exact ownership; advisory outcomes never assign credits.

name: routing-subagent-requests
subject: Retain one sub-agent observation per request identity.
objective: Keep exact ownership joins unique.
acceptance: Missing identities do not match unrelated requests.

name: routing-exact-accounting
subject: Attribute each accounting record to exactly one traffic bucket.
objective: Keep detection, evals, classifier, exact sub-agent, main, unsplit and unattributed credits distinct.
acceptance: Detection and evals use phase, missing purpose is never agent by default, and snapshot credits are excluded.

name: routing-correlation-usage-candidates
subject: Find accounting records without exact sub-agent ownership.
objective: Correlate only fully recorded token quartets in file order.
acceptance: Missing token classes never match by model alone.

name: routing-correlation-usage
subject: Order unmatched accounting within model and token quartet.
objective: Match each engine-reported request at most once.
acceptance: Classifier, incomplete and already-exact requests are excluded.

name: routing-correlation-subagent-candidates
subject: Exclude engine requests already matched by proxy request ID.
objective: Prevent exact and correlated ownership from claiming the same request.
acceptance: Only engine requests with a complete quartet and a definition name can correlate.

name: routing-correlation-subagents
subject: Order unmatched engine requests within each model/token quartet.
objective: Produce deterministic one-to-one correlated ownership.
acceptance: Correlation is labelled separately from exact evidence.

name: routing-correlated-accounting
subject: Join proxy usage with unmatched engine requests by model, quartet and occurrence.
objective: Use the spec's correlated sub-agent attribution without duplicating credits.
acceptance: Each engine request and accounting record participates at most once.

name: routing-attributed-accounting
subject: Assign every accounting record to exactly one exclusive bucket.
objective: Keep exact and correlated sub-agent ownership distinct.
acceptance: Phase wins over purpose; missing ownership remains unsplit or unattributed.

name: routing-cost-bucket-totals
subject: Sum nonoverlapping credits with explicit known and unknown coverage.
objective: Show recorded lower bounds by served model and attribution bucket.
acceptance: Unknown costs are counted, not repriced or silently treated as zero; evals remain separate.

name: routing-cost-buckets
subject: Show known credit lower bounds with honest missing-value coverage.
objective: Never display a zero sum when every cost is missing.
acceptance: Every additive measure carries known and unknown record counts.

name: routing-joined-requests
subject: Inspect per-request deviations and outcomes against proxy picks.
objective: Keep requests without accounting visible and never invent a deviation cause.
acceptance: Unmatched requests have unknown cost; each request retains its own requested and selected model.

name: routing-unaccounted-failures
subject: Count failed requests lacking accounting per run.
objective: Recognize only unambiguous AWF-local effort failures.
acceptance: A run-level effort failure cannot assign zero to multiple failed requests.

name: routing-deviations
subject: Resolve explicit local zero costs and preserve all other unknown request costs.
objective: Avoid partial-cost comparisons based on missing accounting.
acceptance: Only guard rejection or an unambiguous local effort failure establishes zero AIC.

name: routing-deviation-totals
subject: Count deviations and their known response credits by phase.
objective: Keep request-share and credit-share denominators distinct.
acceptance: Missing joined AIC is excluded from credit share and counted.

name: routing-deviation-summary
subject: Show deviation shares with explicit response coverage.
objective: Never equate missing request accounting with free traffic.
acceptance: Zero known joined credits produce no credit share.

name: routing-phase-usage
subject: Sum nonoverlapping accounting per run and phase.
objective: Establish complete costs only with known response values.
acceptance: Unknown response costs remain counted.

name: routing-request-coverage
subject: Count requests whose cost remains unknown.
objective: Exclude incomplete runs from distribution comparisons.
acceptance: Unmatched nonlocal requests cannot be treated as free.

name: routing-phase-costs
subject: Evaluate accounting completeness using collected source receipts and request joins.
objective: Exclude partial costs from medians and comparisons.
acceptance: A complete phase has its selected accounting source, no missing AIC and no unaccounted nonlocal requests.

name: routing-agent-costs
subject: Select complete or explicitly partial agent-phase costs.
objective: Keep detection and evals out of agent-phase comparisons.
acceptance: Classifier remains part of agent-phase cost.

name: routing-detection-costs
subject: Retain detection-phase cost completeness separately.
objective: Do not count detection as classifier or agent traffic.
acceptance: Missing detection evidence remains unknown, not zero.

name: routing-cost-runs
subject: Attach accounting completeness to identified routing runs.
objective: Provide comparable costs only for complete runs.
acceptance: An absent cost stays unknown and never inherits aggregate run AIC.

name: routing-cost-distribution-totals
subject: Compare complete agent-phase AIC by workflow, routing state and pick.
objective: Exclude partial runs from quantiles and display their coverage.
acceptance: Comparisons are observational and do not imply a causal routing benefit.

name: routing-cost-distributions
subject: Suppress cost comparisons with insufficient complete samples.
objective: Enforce the configurable minimum sample rather than overstate sparse evidence.
acceptance: Below the default ten complete runs, cost quantiles remain unavailable.

name: routing-weekly-cost-totals
subject: Summarize complete agent-phase costs by UTC ISO week and routing state.
objective: Expose trends without including partial costs.
acceptance: Untimed runs cannot enter time buckets.

name: routing-weekly-cost
subject: Gate weekly medians by complete sample size.
objective: Keep sparse weeks from implying meaningful cost trends.
acceptance: Weeks below the configurable minimum display insufficient data.

name: routing-comparison-totals
subject: Compare complete agent-phase costs for selected and unrouted workflow runs.
objective: Keep explicit and inferred baselines separate.
acceptance: Partial costs never contribute to sample counts or quantiles.

name: routing-explicit-baselines
subject: Read explicitly unrouted baseline costs.
objective: Avoid combining inferred with configured baselines.
acceptance: Only explicitly unrouted runs contribute.

name: routing-inferred-baselines
subject: Read inferred unrouted baseline costs.
objective: Label inference rather than imply explicit routing configuration.
acceptance: Only unrouted_inferred runs contribute.

name: routing-comparisons
subject: Compute observational routed-versus-unrouted cost deltas within one workflow.
objective: Expose both baseline cohorts and their complete sample sizes.
acceptance: Both cohorts must meet the minimum; zero or absent baseline costs produce no ratio.

name: routing-failure-candidates
subject: Read routing failures, upstream errors, steering and exit 78 evidence.
objective: Keep execution failures separate from the routing selection state.
acceptance: A failure after selection never rewrites selected state; free-form error and steering text are absent.

name: routing-failures
subject: Show recorded failure and steering events.
objective: Retain failure evidence independently of selected state.
acceptance: Only explicit identifiers and counters are shown.

name: routing-outcome-totals
subject: Compare recorded agent job outcomes within pick and classifier label cells.
objective: Avoid conflating runtime success with delayed safe-output outcomes or operational value.
acceptance: Unknown outcomes are excluded from success-rate denominators and shown as coverage.

name: routing-outcome-statistics
subject: Compute outcome ratios with known denominators.
objective: Keep excluded unknown job results visible.
acceptance: Missing denominators remain unknown.

name: routing-outcomes
subject: Gate outcome comparisons with explicit sample coverage.
objective: Avoid presenting sparse pick cohorts as reliable comparisons.
acceptance: Success rates and intervals need enough known outcomes; cost per success also needs enough complete costs.

name: routing-resolutions
subject: Read runner-written configured-model resolutions for scoped routing runs.
objective: Explain what each workflow role's configured model resolved to before the engine launched.
acceptance: Only model.resolution facts from latest scoped attempts contribute; missing or unsafe values and failed null resolutions remain unknown.

name: routing-resolution-status
subject: Count configured-model resolution outcomes by event engine and role.
objective: Show resolved, exact and failed resolutions without multiplying runs by roles.
acceptance: Runs are distinct run identities; records count individual role resolutions.

name: routing-resolution-run-counts
subject: Count resolution records per scoped run.
objective: Attach configured-model resolution evidence to run-level coverage.
acceptance: Several roles in one run remain one covered run.

name: routing-resolution-run-coverage
subject: Classify each scoped run's configured-model resolution evidence.
objective: Separate covered runs, positively routed runs and runs lacking evidence.
acceptance: Absence never establishes routing or failure; routed state comes only from routing evidence.

name: routing-resolution-coverage-totals
subject: Count scoped runs by configured-model resolution coverage.
objective: Keep denominators explicit for covered, routed and missing evidence.
acceptance: Routed runs without resolution are expected absence, not missing evidence.

name: routing-resolution-coverage
subject: Show configured-model resolution coverage with its denominators.
objective: Distinguish expected routed absence from missing resolution evidence.
acceptance: A zero denominator produces no share.

name: routing-resolution-observations
subject: Retain resolutions with a known resolved model.
objective: Build alias history without treating failed or unsafe values as a model.
acceptance: Failed null resolutions and unsafe resolved values never enter alias history.

name: routing-resolution-timeline
subject: Order timed resolutions within each workflow, engine, role, provider and configured model.
objective: Compare only chronologically adjacent resolutions of the same alias series.
acceptance: Untimed runs cannot establish a transition or a first or last observation.

name: routing-resolution-transitions
subject: Mark adjacent resolved-model changes within an alias series.
objective: Count observed alias moves without claiming why they happened.
acceptance: First observations are not changes; equal adjacent models are stable.

name: routing-alias-model-runs
subject: Identify the first and last timed run for each resolved model of a series.
objective: Link alias history rows to their contributing runs.
acceptance: Only timed runs identify first and last observations.

name: routing-alias-history-totals
subject: Count runs and recorded clocks for each resolved model of an alias series.
objective: Expose resolved-model history per workflow, engine, role, provider and configured model.
acceptance: Distinct runs are counted once; untimed runs remain counted with unknown time.

name: routing-alias-history
subject: Show the observed resolved-model history of each alias series.
objective: Support investigation of alias moves with first and last observed runs.
acceptance: History rows are observations, not proof that the model was served.

name: routing-alias-sequences
subject: Summarize timed resolved-model changes for each alias series.
objective: Identify the earliest and latest resolved model and the observed transitions.
acceptance: Transitions require adjacent recorded run clocks.

name: routing-alias-move-totals
subject: Count runs and distinct resolved models for each alias series.
objective: Provide one change-summary row per series, including stable aliases.
acceptance: Engine, role and provider stay part of the series so unrelated resolutions cannot manufacture a move.

name: routing-alias-moves
subject: Highlight alias series whose resolved model changed between timed runs.
objective: Investigate aliases moving to newer models without claiming cause or served-model evidence.
acceptance: Exactly one row per series; only adjacent timed runs establish a move and unordered changes stay distinct.

name: routing-resolution-failure-records
subject: Retain failed configured-model resolutions with their runs.
objective: Link each failed resolution to its contributing run.
acceptance: Failed resolved models stay unknown; causes are never inferred.

name: routing-resolution-failures
subject: Group failed resolutions by configured model and cause.
objective: Keep model_unavailable and catalog_unavailable distinct with engine and role context.
acceptance: Affected runs are distinct run identities; a single-run group links to that run.

name: simulator-database-inputs
subject: Model daily run volume and 30-day retained detail from user-supplied scenario inputs.
objective: Compare hypothetical workload choices without treating results as observed activity.
acceptance: Each simulated day uses the selected inputs; skipped runs retain summaries and detailed records have a 30-day lifetime.
description: Each simulated day includes all accumulated run summaries; tools and issues belong only to non-skipped runs and expire after 30 days.

name: simulator-run-size
subject: Estimate retained run-summary table size at 512 bytes per run.
objective: Show modeled accumulation of run summaries.
acceptance: Summary size includes every simulated run at 512 bytes and is not presented as measured storage.

name: simulator-tool-size
subject: Estimate retained tool table size at 256 bytes per tool on non-skipped runs.
objective: Show modeled tool-record growth under the selected workload.
acceptance: Tool size uses only non-skipped simulated runs and 256 bytes per tool over the retained period.

name: simulator-issue-size
subject: Estimate retained issue table size at 512 bytes per issue on non-skipped runs.
objective: Show modeled issue-record growth under the selected workload.
acceptance: Issue size uses only non-skipped simulated runs and 512 bytes per issue over the retained period.

name: simulator-database-size
subject: Show modeled run-summary, tool, and issue table bytes after 30 days.
objective: Compare hypothetical database table sizes at the end of the retention horizon.
acceptance: The model presents separate summary, tool, and issue estimates after 30 simulated days, never observed storage.
description: Run summaries accumulate; detailed records have a 30-day TTL.

name: simulator-database-total
subject: Sum the modeled table sizes after 30 days.
objective: Show the final estimated size of the modeled database tables.
acceptance: The final value is the sum of the three modeled table sizes after 30 days.

name: simulator-database-summary
subject: List modeled table sizes and their final total after 30 days.
objective: Present the 30-day estimate in a compact table.
acceptance: Three modeled table sizes and their summed final value are shown without a growth chart.

name: overview-run-summary
subject: Summarize successful, failed, and active runs with rollout-mode counts.
objective: Expose observed success, failure, and active run counts, including active live and review modes, for the selected horizon.
acceptance: Each count follows its declared conclusion, status, and rollout-mode filters; run success is not treated as a verified outcome, and incomplete or stale evidence is identified.

name: overview-delivery-summary
subject: Count distinct target repositories with successful worker dispatch runs in the selected horizon.
objective: Measure observed reach among registered repositories with successful dispatched worker runs.
acceptance: Distinct delivered-repositories is limited to registered targets and successful workflow_dispatch worker runs in the selected horizon; it does not establish accepted delivery or authorized coverage.

name: overview-value-summary
subject: Count all observed grader results.
objective: Identify whether any grader observations are available to the Overview status presentation.
acceptance: The value-gains field counts observed grader records only; inspect each result's native measure, unit, direction, maturity, and uncertainty before claiming an outcome or improvement.

name: overview-issue-summary
subject: Count retained issue and pull request safe-output records for Overview.
objective: Restore the issue and pull request counter with a link to its evidence inventory.
acceptance: The count includes retained canonical issue and pull request records, not inferred outcomes; unavailable evidence remains unavailable.

name: overview-issue-station
subject: Present the retained issue and pull request count for Overview.
objective: Provide a presentation-ready count and accessible evidence description.
acceptance: The value matches overview-issue-summary and describes retained safe outputs, not accepted outcomes.

name: overview-value-station
subject: Present the observed grader-result count as the legacy Value gains counter.
objective: Restore the Value gains counter while making its observation-count semantics explicit.
acceptance: The count matches overview-value-summary, including zero; grader presence is not proof of improvement and unavailable evidence is not zero.

args.value: observed grader results, not verified improvements

name: overview-run-status-input
subject: Prepare the compact run summary for declarative factory status classification.
objective: Carry successful-runs, failed-runs, and active-runs into the status join without changing their meaning.
acceptance: The projected counts retain the selected horizon and match overview-run-summary; the join key is only a presentation key, not additional evidence.

name: overview-value-status-input
subject: Prepare the compact value summary for declarative factory status classification.
objective: Carry the grader-observation count into the optional status join.
acceptance: The projected value-gains count matches overview-value-summary; a zero count does not establish complete grader coverage, and a nonzero count is not proof of gain.

name: overview-factory-status
subject: Classify the factory heading from compact run and optional value evidence.
objective: Provide a bounded Overview heading based on observed run counts and optional grader-record presence.
acceptance: The heading matches the declared run-count and optional grader-presence branches; grader presence is not verified value, and the heading does not authorize any policy change.

name: overview-registered-repository-summary
subject: Count canonical repository identities registered in the resolved control-plane scope.
objective: Provide the registered-repository denominator for observed worker reach.
acceptance: The count reflects canonical repository records in the resolved scope; it is not evidence of live enrollment, successful execution, or full inventory completeness.

name: overview-delivery-coverage-input
subject: Prepare successful delivery totals for the repository coverage summary.
objective: Carry the distinct delivered-repositories count into the coverage join.
acceptance: The projected count equals overview-delivery-summary for the selected horizon; the join key adds no repository observations.

name: overview-registered-repository-coverage-input
subject: Prepare registered repository totals for the repository coverage summary.
objective: Carry the registered-repositories count into the coverage denominator join.
acceptance: The projected count equals overview-registered-repository-summary for the resolved scope; missing inventory is not treated as zero eligible targets.

name: overview-rhythm
subject: Compare all workflow runs by weekday, layering this week over last week.
objective: Show the observed weekday pattern across both calendar weeks, regardless of status or conclusion.
acceptance: Verify weekday order, counts including unsuccessful and in-flight runs, and reached-day flags. Missing rhythm is unavailable, not zero activity; do not attribute changes to workflow improvements.

name: overview-repository-coverage-summary
subject: Aggregate reached and total repositories across the resolved organization scope.
objective: Pair observed reached-repositories and registered-repositories-total for a comparable coverage denominator.
acceptance: Both totals come from their named input queries and share the resolved scope; verify the left-joined inventory source independently before interpreting a zero total, since a missing join can aggregate to zero.

name: overview-repository-coverage
subject: Measure registered repository reach from successful worker execution.
objective: Present observed successful-worker repository reach as a ratio alongside numerator and denominator.
acceptance: repository-coverage is reached-repositories divided by registered-repositories-total when available; preserve the counts and undefined denominator, and do not call reach successful outcomes.

name: overview-workflow-health-groups
subject: Assess current runtime failures for every workflow across CAO and targeted repositories.
objective: Compute the latest consecutive completed-run failure streak for each repository-scoped workflow without requiring campaign membership.
acceptance: Group by organization, repository, and workflow; in-flight retries do not clear failures, and later non-failing completed runs reset the streak within the selected horizon.

name: overview-workflow-health-summary
subject: Count all registered workflows and those without current observed runtime failures.
objective: Provide Factory health numerator and denominator across CAO and targeted repositories, including standalone and campaign workflows.
acceptance: Each repository-scoped workflow counts once regardless of campaign or role; no retained failure is not proof of successful execution, missing inventory remains unavailable, and missing run evidence marks the result incomplete.

name: overview-workflow-health-presentation-input
subject: Prepare all-workflow health counts for Overview presentation.
objective: Carry Factory health counts into the header and station presentation.
acceptance: Both counts match overview-workflow-health-summary and preserve missing evidence metadata.

name: overview-factory-health-presentation
subject: Produce presentation-ready Factory health values for the Overview header and floor.
objective: Display the ratio of workflows without current observed runtime failures to all registered workflows with both underlying counts.
acceptance: The percentage and detail agree with healthy-workflows and workflows; a missing or zero denominator remains unavailable, and the ratio is not proof of impact.

name: overview-header-status-presentation-input
subject: Prepare the factory status heading for the declarative Overview header.
objective: Carry the factory heading into the Overview header join unchanged.
acceptance: The heading matches overview-factory-status; the presentation key does not imply additional evidence or a policy recommendation.

name: overview-header-presentation
subject: Resolve the Overview heading from declarative status and factory-health evidence.
objective: Display the configured heading corresponding to observed run status and factory health.
acceptance: The selected heading follows the declared presentation branches; numeric branch boundaries are UI classification only, not operational targets or rollout thresholds.

name: overview-run-motion-presentation-input
subject: Prepare active run state for Overview station presentation.
objective: Expose whether at least one queued or in-progress run was observed for station display.
acceptance: active reflects overview-run-summary's active-runs count; no observed active run does not prove the fleet is idle when the snapshot is incomplete.

name: overview-factory-station
subject: Provide the presentation-ready Factory health station for Overview.
objective: Show the all-workflow runtime health ratio, supporting counts, and observed run motion together.
acceptance: Station value, display, detail, description, and active flag match their input queries; neither absence of failures nor run motion is verified workflow effectiveness.

name: overview-repository-station-presentation-input
subject: Prepare repository coverage for the presentation-ready Overview station.
objective: Format repository reach with its reached and registered counts for the station.
acceptance: The percentage and detail preserve overview-repository-coverage's numerator and denominator; unavailable coverage remains unavailable, not zero or complete reach.

name: overview-repository-station
subject: Provide the presentation-ready repository coverage station for Overview.
objective: Show observed registered-repository worker reach and run motion in one station.
acceptance: Value and formatted evidence match the coverage presentation input, and active matches run motion; neither changes policy or establishes accepted outcomes.

name: campaign-cost-totals
subject: Sum observed AI Credit cost across declared campaign orchestrators and workers.
objective: Attribute retained workflow AIC totals to centrally managed campaigns without computing unrelated inventory metrics.
acceptance: Sum only positive recorded orchestrator and worker workflow AIC by campaign; exclude workflows with zero or missing costs rather than treating them as free execution.

name: cost-by-campaign
subject: Present observed AI Credit cost grouped by centrally managed campaign.
objective: Identify campaigns whose observed AI Credit use needs investigation.
acceptance: Rows preserve positive recorded native aic values and descending order; exclude campaigns without recorded positive costs rather than inferring free execution, savings, or value.

name: cost-by-repository
subject: Present observed AI Credit cost grouped by repository.
objective: Locate repositories with higher observed AI Credit totals for evidence-led investigation.
acceptance: Each repository coordinate and native aic total agrees with repository-aic-totals; confirm the selected horizon and underlying runs before attributing cost or proposing a change.

name: cost-by-workflow
subject: Present observed AI Credit cost grouped by repository-owned workflow.
objective: Locate repository workflows with higher observed AI Credit totals and open their workflow evidence.
acceptance: Workflow identity, link, and native aic total match workflow-aic-totals in descending order; cost alone does not establish waste, quality, or value.

name: cost-per-workflow-run
subject: Present the average observed AI Credit cost of a single run for each repository-owned workflow.
objective: Compare observed AI Credit per run across repository workflows with each observed-runs denominator.
acceptance: Include only workflows with positive-AIC run attempts, and use only those attempts in cost averages; observed-runs still counts all retained attempts.
description: Observed AI Credit totals divided by positive-AIC run attempts for each declared workflow.

name: failure-run-base
subject: Select retained runs with failure, startup-failure, stale, or timed-out conclusions for the failed-run ledger and streak inputs.
objective: Provide one consistent failure-conclusion evidence set to downstream Overview queries.
acceptance: Each selected run has one of the four declared conclusions within the selected horizon; other conclusions remain outside this set, and missing run coverage is not interpreted as no failures.

name: failed-runs
subject: List failed workflow runs that need operator attention.
objective: Give operators the most recent observed failed runs to inspect in GitHub.
acceptance: Unprojected run rows retain available conclusion, started-at, and run evidence fields in descending started-at order; inspect source logs and missing links before attributing a cause or declaring resolution.

name: overview-failing-runs
subject: Identify failed runs in the selected snapshot horizon so subsequent streak logic can use the same declarative failure definition.
objective: Project distinct failure-run counts by organization, repository, workflow, and run for streak joins.
acceptance: Each grouped run identity has a failing-runs count derived from failure-run-base in the selected horizon; this stage does not assert a consecutive streak or require action.

name: overview-failing-workflows
subject: Identify only workflows that have at least one failed run in the selected snapshot horizon before computing streaks.
objective: Provide workflow identities with observed failed runs for the streak computation.
acceptance: Each organization/repository/workflow group has a distinct failing-runs count from overview-failing-runs; the count covers observed failures, not the latest consecutive streak.

name: overview-repeated-failure-groups
subject: Group each workflow's latest consecutive failing run sequence in the selected snapshot horizon, resetting the group after any successful run.
objective: Project the latest observed consecutive failure-count per workflow for downstream blocked-work matching.
acceptance: failure-count follows run ordering and the declared latest-failure-streak reducer, with non-failing runs breaking the streak; missing earlier runs or incomplete snapshots limit the observed sequence.

name: overview-repeated-failure-candidates
subject: Attach selected-horizon failure counts to each workflow's latest canonical work item.
objective: Pair blocked work items with observed workflow failure streaks and retained run evidence before attention filtering.
acceptance: Candidates are filtered to blocked items with a matching organization/repository/workflow streak; is-repeated reflects failure-count greater than one, while selected evidence-link and run-link can be absent or refer to the work item rather than the latest failed run.

name: overview-repeated-failure-attention
subject: Keep only unresolved workflows with two or more failures in the selected horizon.
objective: Surface blocked workflow items with observed repeated failures for bounded run investigation.
acceptance: Every row inherits a blocked item with is-repeated true and projects evidence-link and run-link when available; verify run order, links, and current state before treating the failure as still unresolved.

name: overview-review-attention
subject: Select only unresolved outputs explicitly awaiting human review with their retained GitHub evidence destination.
objective: Present review-state work items and their retained GitHub destination to a human reviewer.
acceptance: Rows are filtered to lifecycle-state review and project the work-item ID as attention-signal-id, plus reason, evidence-link, and run-link where present; reviewer disposition must be checked at source.

name: overview-needs-attention
subject: Combine grouped repeated failures and unresolved review outputs without introducing ordinary activity or duplicate work items.
objective: Prioritize observed blocked repeated-failure work and review-state outputs for investigation.
acceptance: Rows come only from the repeated-failure or review inputs and retain their source reasons, links, and ordering; confirm fresh source status before acting, and do not equate a missing row with resolved work.

name: domain-route-record
subject: Project the selected domain header and one retained run link.
objective: Identify the selected domain and open a retained run before investigating its traffic evidence.
acceptance: The route header preserves the selected domain and a run link from its retained observations; missing observations or links remain unavailable, and a header does not establish access policy or traffic completeness.

name: tool-route-record
subject: Project the selected MCP tool header and one retained run link.
objective: Identify the selected MCP tool and open a retained run before investigating its call evidence.
acceptance: The route header preserves the selected MCP tool label and a run link from its retained calls; absent calls or links remain unavailable and do not imply zero usage or tool effectiveness.

name: audit-route-record
subject: Project the selected audit summary header and one retained run link.
objective: Identify the selected audit summary and open a retained run before investigating its observations.
acceptance: The route header preserves the selected event summary and a run link from its retained audit observations; absent evidence remains unavailable and neither the header nor its absence establishes incident severity or a clean audit.

name: domain-entity-insights
subject: Summarize one domain entity for its dedicated Insights view.
objective: Identify domain decisions with request volume worth investigating before considering any egress change.
acceptance: For the selected domain, request totals match the retained domain observations grouped by decision; missing data or blocked traffic does not establish a need for access, which requires underlying request and policy review.

name: tool-entity-insights
subject: Summarize one tool entity for its dedicated Insights view.
objective: Select a tool and status combination whose recorded call volume merits investigation.
acceptance: For the selected tool, observation counts match retained MCP call observations grouped by server, tool, and status; missing calls are not zero usage and status counts do not establish effectiveness or cause.

name: audit-entity-insights
subject: Summarize one audit event entity for its dedicated Insights view.
objective: Select an audit summary and status requiring closer review of underlying observations.
acceptance: For the selected summary, counts agree with retained audit observation IDs grouped by event status; repeated observations are not silently treated as distinct incidents, and absence does not prove no findings.
